'''"Worm Case"''' was a [[Music/Legends|song]] performed by [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] it was requested in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] by a tanned [[Gender/Legends|female]] "for [[Laze Loneozner/Legends|Fixer]] and [[Camie Loneozner|Camie]]."
